_comment: Compressed receipts (tarballs and gzip files) under docs/benchmarks, results, baselines and qrels, reviewed member by member on 2026-11-01 at cb8f4665 (#221); before then neither receipt guard read inside them. Secret review: the pinned gitleaks named below, run over every member, reported 24,331 findings and none is a credential. 24,319 are its generic-api-key rule on JSON keys that contain "token" or "key": tokenizer names ("cl100k", "approx-chars-div-4"), sha256 memo keys and gpth_ retrieval cache keys in the budgeted-delivery rows, and gbrain's random sync-lock UUIDs (token, acquisition_token) in the managed-sync stall samples. The other 12 are the jwt.io sample token (HS256, sub 1234567890, name John Doe), which a BEAM conversation quotes as sample code, in one wave-2 comparator cell (beam-500k-comparator-rag-13b8f315a8f6, question 1_summarization_0). Machine-path review: 1,807 hold no machine-local path, 125 memory-proof-wave cell tarballs hold only the exempt VM overlay path below, and 63 hold other paths, kept as evidence: sandbox homes (/home/agent, /root, /home/alice-example) and /tmp in Cat 41 and agent-operator session logs, Ubicloud cell stores under /home/ubi/cells and VM /tmp paths in memory-proof-wave receipts, Capy machine paths (/workspace/ in the embedding-matrix receipts and in Cat 41 and agent-operator session logs, ~/.capy/work in the wave-2 re-judge proxy log, /home/user/gbrain@48ed5e82 in an n2-judges capture), and /home/user/Documents paths quoted in benchmark conversations. These files stay byte for byte. test/eval/receipt-machine-paths.test.ts reads every other compressed receipt member by member, and scripts/scan-receipts.sh secret-scans it; both skip a file listed here only while its sha256 matches, and the secret scan only while gitleaks is still the version named here. To list a new compressed receipt, review its members the same way and record what they hold.

exempt_machine_paths./home/ubi/work/gbrain-evals/.gbrain-over: The memory-proof-wave harness's overlay checkout on its ephemeral Ubicloud VM. Each ingest stage record in its cell receipts names the gbrain CLI there (gbrain.cli, as <overlay>/<gbrain sha>/src/cli.ts), which identifies the build and no person or reusable machine. Exempt from the machine-path check inside compressed receipts only; scripts/scan-receipts.sh still secret-scans those members.
